acceptanceCriteria: A spec or decision states whether Corvint release archives carry build provenance and an SBOM, the format chosen, and the trust root, without adding a network dependency to the default local product path.

If accepted: the release workflow emits provenance and an SBOM per archive, and corvint-update gains an opt-in verification mode that refuses on a missing or mismatched attestation and reports NOT_OBSERVED when offline instead of implying verification.
Checksum-only verification remains the documented fallback and its qualification limits stay visible.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Idea from reviewing backnotprop/plannotator (2026-10-06): its releases ship SHA256 sidecars, SLSA build provenance and a CycloneDX SBOM gated by a vulnerability scan, and its installer has an opt-in --verify-attestation flag that runs gh attestation verify. Corvint's release-artifact-integrity-v0 explicitly leaves signing, attestation and SBOM out of scope (ARTIFACT-GO-V0-008, open-question section), and corvint-update verifies checksums only. Proof-carrying context should come with proof-carrying binaries.
title: Release supply-chain evidence: SLSA build provenance, an SBOM and verifiable attestations checked by corvint-update and the installer
